title: New Dance Cos'mos
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Couples don't end the round where the progression puts them.
choices: Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
